clauses.title: Scope – Requirements and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements  and the methods of sampling and test for thermal linsulating cements for use at temperatures up to 950ºC.

clauses.title: Types –
clauses.text: 2. Types - Type 350 -  for use of temperatures up to 350º C, Type 750 -  for use of temperatures up to 750ºC,and Type 950 -  for use of temperatures up to 950º C. clauses.title: Requirements – The material
clauses.text: 3. Requirements - The material shall be in the form of dry powder and/or granulated aggregate. The material shall also conform to the requirements given in Table 1.
